word: At each table there are four or five people.
answer: En cada mesa hay cuatro o cinco personas.

word: In the special of the day, there is soup, potatoes, vegetables, salad, dessert, and coffee or tea.
answer: En el especial del día, hay sopa, papas, vegetales, ensalada, postre, y café o té.

word: On the menu, there is chicken, meat, and much fish.
answer: En el menú, hay pollo, carne y mucho pescado.

word: On the second floor, there are drinks also and the dish of the day.
answer: En el segundo piso, hay bebidas también y el plato del día.

word: It is one o'clock in the afternoon and the Spanish restaurant is full.
answer: Es la una de la tarde y el restaurante español está lleno.

word: It is a popular and inexpensive restaurant.
answer: Es un restaurante popular y económico.

word: There are eighteen tables and five excellent waiters.
answer: Hay dieciocho mesas y cinco camareros excelentes.

word: There are two floors; on the first floor, there are drinks and tapas.
answer: Hay dos pisos; en el primer piso, hay bebidas y tapas.

word: The people are happy because it is a holiday and there is no work.
answer: La gente está alegre porque es un día de fiesta y no hay trabajo.
